evidence: Modifies package acceptance and eviction logic in src/validation.cpp to support package feerate evaluation and sibling eviction checks during test acceptance.
rationale: Allows wallets to pre-flight test package acceptance and package RBF without mutating mempool state. While useful for dry-running 1p1c CPFP packages, this is an incremental addition to test-acceptance capabilities rather than a fix for DoS or pinning resistance.
